parameters.name: serializer_view
parameters.description:
Controls the RFI list item response shape. The default response schema shown
for this endpoint documents the standard list item shape; the values below
return alternate shapes used by existing clients.

- `ids_only` - Returns an array of RFI IDs only. Filters and pagination apply
  as usual, but `search`, `q`, and `sort[attribute]` are ignored for this
  view; results are always ordered by RFI ID descending.
- `base_web_index` - Returns compact web index objects containing only the RFI
  ID, full RFI number, and subject.
- `web_index` - Returns web index objects with list display fields, full
  object associations for project stage, cost code, location, sub job,
  responsible contractor, user fields, assignees, ball-in-court users, custom
  fields, requester edit permissions, linked external RFIs, and connected RFI
  origin data.
- `flatten_v0` - Returns flattened mobile-compatible objects with related
  resource IDs instead of several full objects, question and answer data,
  assignees, ball-in-court users, distribution list users, linked external
  RFIs, deletion metadata, and connected RFI origin data.
- Default (not specified) - Returns the standard RFI list item shape shown in
  the response schema.

Unrecognized values are not rejected. Any value outside the list above returns
the default RFI list item shape, so a misspelled view returns a successful
response in the wrong shape.

x-changelog.summary: Added connect_export_origin to RFI list response
x-changelog.description: The RFI list response now includes a connect_export_origin object on each list item when the RFI was exported via cross-account collaboration. The object contains source_provider_name (the originating company or project name) and rfi_number (the originating RFI number). Returns null for RFIs without a cross-collaboration origin.

x-changelog.summary: Added `reference` field to the `flatten_v0` serializer view
x-changelog.description: The `reference` field is now included in the response when using `serializer_view=flatten_v0`. Previously, this field was only available in the default and extended views. The field is a nullable string  and its value is identical to what is returned by the standard v1.0 API.

x-changelog.summary: Documented RFI list serializer_view response variants
x-changelog.description: The RFI list API documentation now describes the supported `serializer_view` values and the response shape returned by each view, including `ids_only`, `base_web_index`, `web_index`, and `flatten_v0`.

x-changelog.summary: Documented additional RFI list filters, sort attributes, and search alias
x-changelog.description: The RFI list API documentation now describes filters that the endpoint has always accepted but did not document: `current_revision`, `sub_job_id`, `priority`, `overdue`, `linked_to_external_rfis`, `linked_to_connected_rfis`, `for_location_id_with_sublocations`, and `initiated_at`. Existing ID filters are now documented as accepting a single value or an array, `filters[status]` documents the `closed_with_revision` and `closed_draft` values, and `filters[number]` is corrected to a string because it matches the full RFI number rather than a numeric ID. `sort[attribute]` documents the `ball_in_court_id`, `priority`, and `status` values, and the `q` search alias and `as_datetimes` parameters are now listed.

x-changelog.summary: Documented linked external RFI status, sync, and connection values
x-changelog.description: The linked external RFI objects returned by the `web_index` and `flatten_v0` RFI list views now document their allowed values. `status` includes the existing `_recycled` variants returned when the upstream RFI is in the recycle bin, `sync_status` documents `in_sync` and `upstream_private`, and `connection_status` documents `connected` and `disconnected`. Integrations should tolerate unknown future values.

x-changelog.summary: Corrected documented RFI response status values
x-changelog.description: The standard and extended RFI response schemas now document the existing `closed_with_revision` and `closed_draft` status values and no longer list `recycled`, which is not returned as an RFI status. Generated clients should handle the newly documented values and tolerate unknown future status values.
